body.x: HereO(www.hereofamily.com) introduced a GPS tracking device for kids "hereO Watch" at CES Unveiled, a pre-show of CES 2015 which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.HereO Watch was manufactured at half the size of adult watches to accommodate to children's wrist sizes.By using the GPS system, parents are informed when the child leaves the designated area or the battery runs out with hereO family APP. Also, there is an emergency button to press in case of emergency.
